Experience Required: 5+ Years

Location: Hyderabad

l Experience in technical hiring, preferably in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Defense, Aerospace, or Manufacturing domains.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Tech Domain Specialist – Modern Workplace**

We are seeking an experienced Modern Workplace and End User Computing professional to provide technical leadership across enterprise Endpoint Management services. The role will own and evolve capabilities across Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Windows, endpoint security, automation, application management and Digital Employee Experience, ensuring services remain secure, scalable and aligned with business needs.

Beyond day-to-day engineering, the role will **shape technology roadmaps, influence architectural decisions, drive continuous improvement and evaluate emerging capabilities** across the Modern Workplace ecosystem. A key future focus will be understanding how **AI, intelligent automation and data-driven insights** can enhance endpoint operations, employee experience and productivity.

**Primary Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Modern End User Computing infrastructure, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in **Microsoft Intune** and **SCCM** .
* Experience with Microsoft technologies including **Windows 10/11, Active Directory, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Microsoft 365** .
* Strong Intune administration & Engineering experience including user management, application packaging and deployment, service administration, PR & Platform scripting, compliance policies, and device profile management.
* Expertise in **Intune Conditional Access, Device Compliance, Software Update Management, Endpoint Security, and Device Configuration Policies** .
* Ability to coordinate and manage enterprise device provisioning using **Intune Autopilot** and **SCCM** .
* Manage global software distribution, Microsoft security updates, and standard desktop software deployments.
* Prioritize and coordinate security patching, software testing, validation, and enterprise-wide deployments and knowledge/experience on third party patching solutions.
* Develop and maintain **Power BI dashboards, operational reports, and executive-level reporting** for endpoint compliance, software lifecycle management, device health, inventory, and security posture.
* Strong automation capabilities using **PowerShell and VB Scripting** for endpoint administration, software deployment, remediation, and operational process automation.
* Work with corporate security teams to identify, assess, and remediate endpoint security risks.
* Meet with internal stakeholders to assess business needs, identify challenges, and define project scope and deliverables.
* Deep understanding & hand on experience with Digital Employee Experience platforms such as **Nexthink** or **SysTrack** .
* Strong understanding of endpoint security technologies, security baselines, and modern workplace security patterns.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to influence outcomes, drive adoption, and gain buy-in for new initiatives and ways of working.
* Product-oriented mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrable thought leadership and passion for Modern Workplace, Digital Employee Experience, and Endpoint Management services.
* Strong awareness of IT Service Management principles and **ITIL** practices.
* Develop and drive the **Endpoint Management and Modern Workplace roadmap** , aligning technology investments with business objectives, security requirements, and employee experience goals.
* Partner with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Digital Workplace teams to define and implement strategic initiatives that improve endpoint security, automation, operational efficiency, and user productivity.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and Microsoft roadmap capabilities, providing recommendations to leadership on future-state workplace services and platform modernization.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging automation, analytics, and data-driven insights to optimize service performance, compliance, and operational effectiveness.  

**Additional/Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM)** solutions such as **BeyondTrust EP & CyberArk, Intune.**
* Awareness of Responsible AI, data privacy, security and governance considerations, with the ability to support safe and responsible adoption of AI capabilities.
* Understanding of how AI can complement automation and endpoint telemetry to improve troubleshooting, operational decision-making, knowledge management and service efficiency.
* Understanding of networking concepts including **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Firewalls, DMZs, Proxy Services, Secure Network Architectures, and Endpoint Connectivity** .
* Experience with **REST API integrations** , automation orchestration, and system integrations.
* Exposure to **Microsoft Defender for Endpoint** , Endpoint Analytics, and security operations reporting.
* Experience integrating **Intune, SCCM, Nexthink, Microsoft Defender, and other endpoint management platforms** into centralized reporting and monitoring solutions.
* Knowledge of cloud-based endpoint management and modern workplace transformation initiatives.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications such as **MCSE, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate, Security Certifications** , or equivalent.

**Basic/Primary Qualifications:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

* Bachelor’s degree in **computer science, Information Technology, Engineering** , or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* **10+ years of experience** in End User Computing, Modern Workplace, Endpoint Management, or related technology services.
* **5+ years of experience** working with Microsoft Intune, SCCM and enterprise endpoint management technologies.
* Demonstrated experience in **automation, scripting and data-driven service improvement** .
* Experience with **Digital Employee Experience (DEX)** platforms and endpoint analytics.
* Proven ability to **lead technical initiatives, influence stakeholders and drive technology adoption** across complex enterprise environments.
* Excellent **communication, stakeholder management and strategic problem-solving** skills.

**Preferred Qualifications/Knowledge:**

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

* Strong understanding of **ITIL, service management, security and technology governance** principles.
* Good understanding of **Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, AI-driven automation and emerging workplace technologies** .
* Relevant Microsoft certifications such as **M365, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, Identity and Access Management, Azure, Security Certifications** , or equivalent.
* Ability to collaborate across matrixed organizations
* Exposure to **Endpoint Privilege Management, Remote Support and modern device security capabilities** .

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced network engineering leader to help drive the design, modernization, support, and evolution of Nielsen’s enterprise network environment in India. This role is not limited to end-user experience. It is a broad technical lead role spanning network architecture, core infrastructure modernization, VPN transformation, network segmentation, security controls, operational stability, and cross-functional delivery.

You will serve as a technical lead across both project and operational domains, partnering with network engineering, NOC, cybersecurity, cloud/platform teams, application owners, local IT, and support teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient network services. This person should be equally comfortable working in product-oriented environments that prioritize speed and roadmap execution, and in support-oriented organizations that require operational rigor, incident response, stability, and service excellence.

**Role overview**

This position will lead technical direction across enterprise networking initiatives, with a strong focus on architecture, modernization, and execution. The successful candidate will help evolve legacy environments into well-governed, enterprise-grade network platforms while also supporting ongoing production operations and mentoring engineers across the team.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead network architecture and modernization initiatives across campus, branch, datacenter, internet edge, remote access, and hybrid cloud connectivity environments.
* Act as the technical lead for VPN strategy and transformation, including modernization of remote access models, alignment with next-generation firewall capabilities, and improvements to secure user and site connectivity.
* Drive network segmentation initiatives to improve security posture, limit lateral movement, and establish risk-based trust zones and access controls without disrupting business operations.
* Partner with cybersecurity, application teams, server owners, and change management teams to design, test, and implement network changes in a controlled and pragmatic manner.
* Provide technical leadership across routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewalling, authentication, and access control domains.
* Support the evolution of enterprise and cloud networking patterns, including hybrid connectivity, governance, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex network incidents, chronic issues, and cross-functional troubleshooting involving support, operations, and engineering teams.
* Create and maintain network diagrams, traffic flow maps, standards, SOPs, and implementation documentation.
* Use traffic analysis, telemetry, firewall logs, and network data sources to identify bottlenecks, reduce risk, and improve performance and reliability.
* Mentor other engineers, influence technical direction, and help establish best practices that balance product agility with enterprise reliability and governance.

 **Qualifications**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, network architecture, and production support in medium to large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience operating as a technical lead or senior engineer across both project delivery and business-as-usual support models.
* Prior experience working in both product-oriented organizations and support/service-oriented organizations.
* Strong background in core networking, including routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise wireless.
* Strong experience with VPN technologies, remote access architecture, firewall policy design, and network security controls.
* Experience leading or materially contributing to network segmentation, access control, and zero trust or trust-zone initiatives.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to lead high-severity issue resolution across multiple teams.
* Experience with authentication and network access technologies such as 802.1x, NAC, RADIUS, and EAP-TLS.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, present risks, negotiate change windows, and align diverse teams.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, and/or Fortinet platforms.
* Experience with SD-WAN, SASE, ZTNA, and modern remote access patterns.
* Experience with cloud networking and hybrid connectivity across AWS and other public cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with automation or infrastructure-as-code approaches for network consistency, governance, and scale.
* Experience in traffic analysis, network visualization, and phased deployment planning.

**What success looks like**

* You provide clear technical leadership across architecture, modernization, and operational support.
* You improve the security and resilience of the network through better segmentation, access design, and lifecycle governance.
* You help modernize VPN and remote connectivity patterns while maintaining a strong user and operational experience.

**Profile summary**

We are seeking a seasoned network engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with operational judgment and strong collaboration skills. You should be comfortable leading change, supporting critical production environments, and shaping network architecture that is secure, modern, scalable, and practical to operate day to day.

* You bridge product velocity and support stability, ensuring network services scale with business needs.
* You raise the technical maturity of the team through mentorship, documentation, standards, and execution discipline.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. description:
**Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations**

**Location:** Bengaluru, India  
**Reporting to:** Global Head of Talent Acquisition

  

**About the Role**

LSEG is seeking a Talent Acquisition leader to lead global hiring for our Operations organisation.

Leading a global team of approximately 20 Talent Acquisition professionals and supporting around 2,000 hires annually, this role oversees one of LSEG’s largest and most operationally complex talent portfolios.

The current portfolio combines significant scale with a strong internal mobility agenda. Approximately 50% of hiring is internal and 50% external, with the majority of activity taking place at Associate or Senior Associate level.

The portfolio is concentrated in major global delivery locations with c55% of volume in India, c25% in the Philippines, and c10% in Poland.

Partnering closely with Operations, People and business leaders, the Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations will deliver outcomes across three strategic priorities: Quality, Speed and Insight. Beyond recruitment delivery, the role acts as a strategic advisor, using talent intelligence, workforce insight and labour-market expertise to influence hiring, skills, location and resourcing decisions.

The portfolio will continue to evolve as technology, automation and AI reshape work and skills requirements. The successful candidate will help Operations anticipate this shift, balancing current delivery at scale with increasing demand for more specialised, analytical, transformation-oriented and senior talent. The role will also maximise opportunities for internal talent movement and career progression.

The successful candidate will be a key member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, contributing to enterprise-wide Talent Acquisition strategy, transformation priorities and the continued evolution of LSEG’s hiring capabilities.

**Scope**

* Global responsibility for Operations Talent Acquisition.
* Leadership of c20 Talent Acquisition professionals across multiple locations.
* Delivery of approximately 2,000 hires annually.
* Accountability for hiring across operational, change, transformation, controls, specialist and leadership disciplines up to Director level.
* Member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, helping shape enterprise Talent Acquisition strategy and priorities.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Strategic Talent Partner
* Develop and implement Talent Acquisition strategies aligned to Operations workforce requirements, location strategy and business priorities.
* Partner with Operations and People leaders to shape workforce plans, anticipate how skills and role requirements will evolve, and address emerging capability gaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor, providing market insight, talent intelligence and data-driven recommendations that improve workforce, location and hiring decisions.
* Help leaders balance external recruitment, internal mobility, capability building and workforce redeployment as the composition of demand changes.
* Hiring Delivery and Performance
* Own end-to-end hiring outcomes for the Operations portfolio, balancing quality, speed, candidate experience and cost.
* Create clear portfolio priorities, service expectations and performance rhythms that translate demand into executable hiring plans.
* Use data to identify demand, capacity, conversion, ageing and location risks, intervening early to improve outcomes.
* Differentiate hiring approaches by segment, combining scalable delivery for recurring demand with specialist-led and advisory models for more complex and senior roles.
* Accelerate internal mobility by improving visibility of opportunities and enabling effective movement of talent across the organisation.

**Leadership and Capability**

* Lead, develop and hold accountable a globally distributed Talent Acquisition team, creating clarity of purpose, priorities and performance expectations.
* Evolve the team’s capability as the portfolio shifts from predominantly high-volume hiring towards more complex, specialist and senior requirements.
* Build an impactful, inclusive team with strong business knowledge, market expertise, commercial judgement and advisory capability.
* Ensure the team deploys capacity flexibly against business priorities and operates effectively across locations and time zones.

**Transformation and Enterprise Contribution**

* Champion consistent, technology-enabled and insight-led hiring practices across the portfolio.
* Use automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve scalability, quality and speed, with appropriate human oversight and governance.
* Help reshape the Talent Acquisition service as workforce demand evolves, ensuring recruiter capacity is increasingly focused on higher-value, complex and advisory work.
* Contribute to enterprise Talent Acquisition priorities and partner across Talent Acquisition, People Services and People Engineering to establish clear accountabilities and effective end-to-end delivery.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Significant Talent Acquisition leadership experience supporting operations, service delivery, business services or similarly complex distributed organisations.
* Proven track record of leading hiring at scale across a broad range of operational and leadership talent, with the judgement to differentiate volume, specialist and senior hiring approaches.
* Strong business partnering and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge, advise and build credibility with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to translate workforce and hiring strategies into measurable business outcomes.
* Experience evolving Talent Acquisition capability and capacity as business demand, skills requirements and service models change.
* Proven experience improving hiring performance through demand management, process discipline, data, technology and clear accountability.
* Experience using talent intelligence and analytics to improve hiring, workforce planning, internal mobility and location decisions.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and change while maintaining delivery focus and team engagement.

**Preferred**

* Experience within financial services, financial markets infrastructure, technology-enabled services, shared services or another highly regulated global environment.
* Experience leading, developing and being accountable for the performance and outcomes of geographically distributed Talent Acquisition teams.
* Experience leading Talent Acquisition across multiple geographies and major operational hubs, particularly India, the Philippines and Poland.
* Responsibility for a talent portfolio of significant scale and complexity, spanning volume, specialist, change and leadership hiring.
* Experience supporting Operations organisations through transformation, organisational redesign, location strategy or operating model change.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled, technology-driven or automation-led Talent Acquisition solutions with appropriate governance and human oversight.
* Experience building internal mobility and talent redeployment into the hiring model.
* Experience working as part of a senior Talent Acquisition or People leadership team, contributing to broader enterprise priorities.

**Why Join LSEG?**

This is an opportunity to lead a significant global Talent Acquisition portfolio at the centre of how LSEG serves customers, manages risk and delivers operational performance.

The immediate challenge is substantial: a team of approximately 20 supporting around 2,000 hires annually across a globally distributed portfolio, with internal mobility accounting for approximately half of hiring. The broader opportunity is to help shape how the portfolio evolves as technology changes work, skills requirements become more complex and a greater share of Talent Acquisition capacity moves towards specialist and advisory activity.

The role offers exposure to senior Operations, People and enterprise leaders globally, and the opportunity to influence workforce composition, location, capability and career mobility across one of LSEG’s largest employee populations.

As a member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, the successful candidate will help shape the future direction of Talent Acquisition across LSEG while partnering directly with Operations leaders on important workforce and transformation priorities.

We are interested in established Talent Acquisition leaders as well as high-potential individuals ready to step into a broader global leadership role. The critical requirement is a track record of leading complex hiring portfolios, developing high-performing teams and influencing business outcomes through talent expertise, insight and execution.

  
  

**ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

**Career Stage:**

Director

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

description:
**About dunnhumby**

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, empowering businesses everywhere to compete and thrive in the modern data-driven economy. We always put the Customer First. Headquartered in London and wholly owned by Tesco, dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas, working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro.

Our mission: to enable businesses to grow and reimagine themselves by becoming advocates and champions for their customers. With deep heritage and expertise in retail – one of the world's most competitive markets, with a deluge of multi-dimensional data – dunnhumby today enables businesses all over the world, across industries, to be Customer First. dunnhumby helps retailers and brands deliver better experiences through Customer First strategies.

**About Tesco Media**

Retail Media is transforming how advertisers connect with consumers through personalized and targeted campaigns across retailers' digital and physical touchpoints. Retail Media Measurement plays a pivotal role in ensuring the effectiveness of these campaigns, driving value for advertisers, retailers, and consumers alike.

Tesco Media is building a world-class, self-serve B2B advertising platform that enables retailers and brands to plan, activate, and measure omnichannel retail media campaigns.

**The role**

We are seeking a talented Lead Engineer with .NET expertise to lead development of a product that helps retailers transform their Retail Media business in a way that helps them achieve maximum ad revenue and enable massive scale.

As a Lead Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and delivering high-quality software solutions. You will be responsible for contributing to system architecture and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. Your technical expertise, leadership skills, and ability to drive results will be key to the success of our products.

**What will you be doing?**

* Design and deliver .NET Core solutions within a microservices architecture, ensuring adherence to compliance, security, and quality standards.

* Implement best practices in coding, CI/CD, and DevOps while balancing delivery timelines with technical excellence.

* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and drive innovation through continuous improvement and process enhancements.

* Focus on improving developer productivity and coach junior team members to achieve their full potential.

* Collaborate with product managers and architects to define technical roadmaps.

**What** **would you need to be successful in the role****?**

* Proven experience leading technical teams and delivering complex projects.

* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms.

* Strong technical expertise in C# and .NET Core, with experience building RESTful APIs and a deep understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, system design, and engineering best practices.

* Strong experience designing distributed systems using microservices and event-driven architecture.

* Familiarity with microservices and event-driven architecture using tools like RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub and Kafka, as well as containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (K8s); cloud platforms (GCP / Azure / AWS); relational databases (Postgres preferred) and analytical databases (BigQuery preferred); and testing frameworks (xUnit / NUnit / Cypress).

* Experience using DevOps tools like GitLab CI/CD and leveraging cloud platforms, particularly GCP or Azure, for scalable solutions.

* A deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native applications, and Unix/Linux environments, alongside expertise in testing strategies, code quality, and secure coding tools like SonarQube and Checkmarx.

* Proficiency with version control systems like Git.

* Adept at using observability tools like New Relic to monitor systems, with solid knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and strong interpersonal and leadership skills to effectively motivate teams.

**Good to have**

* Knowledge of Redis and Elasticsearch.

* Familiarity with the AdTech or Retail domain.

* Work experience, preferably in a product company.

**India benefits and** **perks**

Alongside a competitive rewards package, colleagues in our Gurugram office enjoy:

* Medical, dental and eye insurance

* Cab / shuttle services and a car lease option

* Your birthday off as a paid day

* Log out 3 hours early on the last Friday of every month

* Learning access through our tie-ups with Coursera and Udemy

* Crèche support

* Internet allowance

* Flexible working hours

**What you can expect from us**

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company, but also a degree of personal flexibility you might not, plus thoughtful perks like flexible working hours and your birthday off. You'll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition, with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day, with thriving networks including dh Women's Network, dh Proud, dh Parent's & Carer's, dh One and dh Thrive as the living proof. Everyone's invited.

**Our approach to flexible working**

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work. We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work/life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you, please raise it with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

AHEAD is seeking a senior, customer-facing Technical Consultant to lead delivery of Idira Privilege Cloud (formerly CyberArk Privilege Cloud) implementations. You will own technical workstreams from discovery and design through configuration, integration, testing, and handoff. You will advise customer security, identity, and infrastructure teams, resolve complex implementation issues, and help raise the technical quality of the broader delivery team.

Idira Privilege Cloud is a SaaS privileged-access solution for safeguarding credentials, automating password rotation, and monitoring privileged sessions.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical discovery and translate customer requirements into implementable Privilege Cloud designs, deployment plans, and delivery estimates.
* Own one or more technical workstreams through implementation, integration, testing, issue resolution, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Design and configure core PAM capabilities, including safes, accounts, platforms, access controls, password rotation and reconciliation policies, and privileged-session workflows.
* Lead deployment and troubleshooting of Privilege Cloud connectors and related components, including CPM, PSM, and SSH-based access, in coordination with customer infrastructure teams.
* Plan and oversee onboarding of privileged accounts across Windows, Linux/Unix, directory services, databases, network devices, and business applications.
* Lead integrations with customer identity providers and directory services, including authentication, user and group mapping, and access-model troubleshooting.
* Diagnose complex issues spanning the Idira platform and customer infrastructure; coordinate with vendor or customer teams, communicate impact and options, and drive issues to resolution.
* Review implementation decisions and deliverables for security, operability, and alignment with customer requirements and established practices.
* Serve as a trusted technical contact for customer stakeholders; communicate risks, assumptions, dependencies, and recommendations clearly.
* Coach and support other consultants through design reviews, troubleshooting, knowledge sharing, and practical delivery guidance.
* Contribute technical input to scoping, solution proposals, project plans, and knowledge assets; collaborate with AHEAD architects, project managers, and delivery colleagues across regions.
* Support project travel and reasonable time-zone overlap when required for customer delivery.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, systems engineering, cybersecurity, identity, or privileged access management, including substantial customer-facing delivery.
* 3+ years of hands-on implementation or administration experience with Idira/CyberArk Privilege Cloud or CyberArk PAM.
* Demonstrated ownership of PAM implementation workstreams, including privileged account onboarding, access policies, credential rotation and reconciliation, and/or session management.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, make and explain implementation decisions, and manage delivery dependencies with limited day-to-day oversight.
* Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux/Unix administration, networking fundamentals, DNS, firewalls, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience diagnosing complex integrations across enterprise infrastructure and producing clear technical designs, runbooks, test plans, and handoff documentation.
* Strong customer communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineering and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor peers, lead technical reviews, and collaborate effectively with distributed delivery teams.

### **Certification:**

Applicants must hold at least one current, relevant Idira/CyberArk Privilege Cloud credential or delivery certification. Preferred credentials include:

* **CDE-CPC** — CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer, Privilege Cloud.
* **CPC-SEN** — Sentry – Privilege Cloud.
* Another current, vendor-recognized **CPC or CDE** credential relevant to Privilege Cloud/PAM may be considered.

Candidates with a related CyberArk PAM CDE credential and demonstrable senior-level Privilege Cloud delivery experience may also be considered. Certification names and availability can change; validate the credential title against the current Idira/CyberArk University certification catalog before publishing the posting.

### **Nice to Have Skills:**

* Active Directory: domains, users and groups, service accounts, Group Policy, and domain-joined systems.
* LDAP concepts and directory integrations.
* Advanced Windows Server and Linux/Unix troubleshooting, scripting, and service management.
* Database fundamentals, including accounts, permissions, connectivity, and credential rotation for common relational databases.
* Scripting or automation with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or REST APIs.
* Experience with SIEM integration, audit requirements, secrets management, or enterprise security controls.
* Familiarity with cloud and hybrid environments, virtualization, and network/security appliances.
* Experience contributing to solution scoping, effort estimates, architecture diagrams, and customer-facing proposals.

### **What success looks like:**

* Technical workstreams are delivered with clear ownership, sound implementation decisions, and predictable communication of risks and dependencies.
* Customer environments meet agreed requirements and are documented for secure, sustainable operations.
* Privileged accounts and systems are onboarded with appropriate access, rotation, and session controls.
* Complex technical issues are resolved efficiently, with appropriate customer and vendor coordination.
* Customer administrators can confidently operate the delivered solution after handoff, and less-experienced consultants benefit from the senior consultant’s technical guidance.

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.

**About the Position**

We are seeking an experienced Learning and Development Manager to lead the strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of the Ready for Allocation (RFA) function in India.

The RFA group includes employees awaiting assignment to a client-focused team, typically after completing new-hire training or while transitioning between client engagements. It may also include employees on the bench awaiting project allocation in accordance with company policies.

The L&D Manager, RFA will be accountable for ensuring that employees within RFA remain skilled, engaged, professional, compliant, and ready for timely deployment. The role will oversee workforce-readiness planning, learning-needs identification, upskilling interventions, operational governance, stakeholder coordination, and the overall RFA employee experience.

This position will manage the L&D Coordinator responsible for day-to-day RFA operations and will work closely with Talent Development, Resourcing, HR, Workforce Management, Operations, and business stakeholders. The manager will use workforce data and business requirements to strengthen deployment readiness, reduce skill gaps, improve operational efficiency, and build a scalable RFA operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **RFA Strategy and Governance**

* Define and drive the overall RFA workforce-readiness strategy in alignment with business, resourcing, and talent priorities.
* Establish clear operating standards, governance mechanisms, escalation paths, and accountability measures for the RFA population.
* Translate organizational policies into clear and practical RFA processes, guidelines, and employee expectations.
* Monitor the health and effectiveness of the RFA model and recommend changes based on workforce data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
* Ensure consistency in the management of employees completing training, transitioning between client teams, or awaiting project allocation.

### **Workforce Readiness and Deployment Enablement**

* Oversee the readiness assessment of employees within RFA and ensure that skills, development needs, availability, and deployment status are accurately tracked.
* Partner with Resourcing, HR, Operations, and business leaders to understand upcoming talent requirements and prepare RFA employees for suitable opportunities.
* Identify barriers affecting employee deployment and coordinate appropriate learning, operational, or stakeholder interventions.
* Introduce structured readiness for employees to prepare for client project allocation.
* Provide leadership with timely visibility into workforce readiness, skill availability, development priorities, and deployment risks.

### **Learning Needs and Upskilling**

* Lead training-needs analysis for the RFA population using readiness data, business requirements, performance indicators, and stakeholder inputs.
* Design and oversee targeted upskilling pathways that keep employees client-ready while they await allocation.
* Prioritize learning interventions based on business demand, skill gaps, deployment opportunities, and employee readiness.
* Guide the creation of just-in-time learning resources to address immediate RFA concerns and emerging capability requirements.
* Evaluate the relevance and effectiveness of learning interventions and use findings to improve future programs.
* Collaborate with Talent Development colleagues and subject-matter experts to source, create, or facilitate appropriate learning solutions.

### **Data, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Develop and maintain meaningful RFA dashboards, reports, and management insights.
* Analyze RFA data to identify skill gaps, readiness trends, allocation barriers, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Define and monitor relevant measures for readiness, learning participation, skill development, deployment enablement, compliance, and employee engagement.
* Convert operational data into clear recommendations and decision support for senior stakeholders.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across RFA trackers, reporting tools, and HR systems.
* Use insights to prioritize interventions and demonstrate the business impact of the RFA function.

### **Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop the L&D Coordinator supporting RFA operations and enablement.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals for the coordinator.
* Review the quality and timeliness of readiness tracking, stakeholder communication, learning interventions, and RFA engagement activities.
* Delegate operational responsibilities while maintaining accountability for overall RFA outcomes.
* Build the coordinator’s capability in data analysis, stakeholder management, learning-needs analysis, facilitation, process improvement, and project execution.
* Create a collaborative, accountable, and improvement-oriented team environment.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary Talent Development point of contact for RFA readiness and capability development.
* Build strong relationships with HR, Resourcing, Workforce Management, Operations, client-facing teams, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews to discuss RFA status, deployment priorities, emerging skill requirements, risks, and required actions.
* Clarify ownership across teams and ensure timely follow-through on agreed actions.
* Escalate critical readiness, conduct, compliance, or deployment concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Communicate RFA priorities, expectations, risks, and progress clearly to employees and leadership.

### **Employee Experience, Professionalism, and Compliance**

* Create a structured and constructive experience for employees while they await allocation.
* Ensure employees understand the expectations associated with RFA, including availability, participation, learning completion, professional conduct, and communication.
* Oversee engagement initiatives that promote accountability, continuous learning, and connection to the organization.
* Work with HR and relevant stakeholders to manage recurring concerns related to participation, professionalism, conduct, or compliance.
* Ensure that RFA sessions and communications reinforce applicable company policies and workplace expectations.

### **Process Improvement and Automation**

* Review existing RFA processes to identify inefficiencies, duplication, manual work, and control gaps.
* Lead improvement initiatives that simplify workflows, strengthen accountability, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of information.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring tracking, reporting, reminders, communications, and administrative activities.
* Partner with relevant technology and operations teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standard operating procedures and appropriate documentation for critical RFA processes.
* Encourage the responsible use of technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability and employee support.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant experience in Learning and Development, workforce readiness, talent operations, workforce management, or a related function.
* Experience leading people, projects, programs, or a significant operational workstream.
* Strong understanding of training-needs analysis, learning-program design, facilitation, and capability development.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret workforce data, identify patterns, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort working with HR systems and reporting tools.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to work across Talent Development, HR, Resourcing, Operations, and business teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project-management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes and introduce scalable ways of working.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing a bench, redeployment, talent-pool, transition, or workforce-readiness program.
* Experience leading a coordinator, specialist, trainer, or similar role.
* Experience developing dashboards and reporting for workforce or learning initiatives.
* Exposure to capacity planning, resource allocation, employee transitions, or client-readiness processes.
* Experience with workflow automation, reporting automation, or AI-enabled learning and operational solutions.

title: Senior Manager, Security Operations
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization covering Cloud & Network Security, Detection Engineering (SOC), and Identity & Access Management (IAM). We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0, run a continuous red-team and penetration-testing program with external partners, and work directly with customers on security architecture reviews and briefings. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a Senior Manager to own and lead three connected disciplines: **Cloud Security, IAM, and the Security Operations Center (Detection & Response)**. You will manage and grow engineers and leads across these areas, set technical direction, and be the accountable owner for how Harness secures its cloud infrastructure, controls access to it, and detects and responds to threats against it.

This is a player-coach role. You are expected to go deep technically, make architecture calls, and also build the team, the operating cadence, and the metrics that show security maturity improving quarter over quarter.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Cloud Security**

* Own the security architecture and posture of Harness's multi-cloud and Kubernetes-based production environments, including network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and hardened baselines.
* Drive secure-by-default infrastructure through policy-as-code (e.g., OPA), guardrails in CI/CD, and continuous posture management.
* Partner with Platform and SRE on dedicated-tenant and customer-hosted deployment models, including the controls that make those models safe at enterprise scale.
* Support the security of customer-facing runtime components such as the Harness Delegate, including token scoping, least-privilege execution, and containment of compromised components.

### **Identity & Access Management**

* Own the workforce and workload identity strategy: SSO, MFA, privileged access, just-in-time access, service-account and machine-identity lifecycle, and access reviews.
* Advance Zero Trust principles across internal systems and production, using a central authority model with human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions.
* Reduce standing privilege and credential sprawl; make least privilege measurable and auditable.

### **Security Operations & Detection Engineering**

* Lead the SOC and Detection Engineering function: detection coverage, alert quality, triage, incident response, and on-call readiness.
* Build detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and validate them through purple-team exercises and red-team findings.
* Own the incident response lifecycle, from runbooks and tabletop exercises to post-incident reviews that feed back into engineering and control improvements.
* Improve automation and tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud-native logging) to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

### **Leadership & Program Management**

* Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team; set clear expectations, growth paths, and a healthy on-call culture.
* Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and executive-ready reporting.
* Work with external red-team and penetration-testing partners to scope exercises, triage findings, and drive remediation to closure.
* Support customer trust: contribute to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews, and communicate the shared responsibility model clearly and credibly.
* Present security posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership, including the executive team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* 10+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or security operations, with 3+ years managing technical security teams.
* Deep hands-on experience securing AWS, GCP, and/or Azure and Kubernetes environments at scale.
* Strong IAM background: SSO/federation, privileged access management, workload identity, and Zero Trust architecture.
* Proven experience running or building detection and response capabilities, including incident command for significant events.
* Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native detection tooling, and with writing or reviewing detection logic.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

### **Preferred**

* Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
* Experience with policy-as-code (OPA/Rego), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD security.
* Experience with Enterprise Security.
* Familiarity with securing AI-enabled products and the supply chain around them.
* Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GCP/AWS security specialty, GIAC) are a plus, not a requirement.

*Harness is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive hiring process.*

  

### **What you will have at Harness**

* Experience building a transformative product
* End-to-end ownership of your projects
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefit
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Environmental Health and Safety Specialist
description:
### **Description**

This position is ideal for environmental professionals to join the Environmental Health and Safety Team as an Environmental Health and Safety Specialist, ensuring compliance with environmental legislation, company requirements, and sustainability objectives. Partnering with operations, quality, production, and EHS teams, you’ll provide environmental expertise, regulatory guidance, and compliance support across manufacturing operations. This role is critical in reducing environmental impact, strengthening environmental responsibility, and driving continuous improvement and sustainable development initiatives.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure facility operations comply with applicable environmental regulations related to waste management, emissions, water and wastewater management, and chemical substances.
* Supervise waste management activities, including waste identification, generation assessments, and compliance with local environmental requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams responsible for waste management activities and regulatory obligations.
* Prepare and submit environmental reports and documentation to regulatory authorities within required statutory timelines.
* Develop, maintain, and control environmental documentation, including procedures, work instructions, permits, registers, and administrative decisions.
* Collaborate with external service providers, environmental consultants, waste contractors, and public authorities on environmental matters.
* Participate in internal and external environmental audits and support the implementation of corrective and improvement actions.
* Monitor changes in environmental regulations and recommend actions to ensure ongoing legal compliance.
* Support projects aimed at reducing environmental impact through waste reduction, resource efficiency, and sustainability initiatives.
* Prepare environmental analyses and reports covering emissions management, transport of dangerous goods, environmental fees, and packaging-related requirements.
* Collaborate with operations, quality, production, and EHS teams regarding environmental requirements and compliance activities.
* Participate in departmental and organizational continuous improvement initiatives focused on environmental performance.
* Support the broader EHS team in executing environmental, health, and safety responsibilities and strategic objectives.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

Education: University degree in Environmental Protection, Environmental Engineering, or a related field. Postgraduate qualification in Occupational Health and Safety is preferred.
  
Experience: At least 3 years of experience independently performing Environmental Specialist responsibilities, preferably within a manufacturing environment or an organization with complex operational processes. Strong practical knowledge of environmental legislation, environmental reporting, permit management, and regulatory authority interactions.
  
Skills: Knowledge of environmental reporting systems and processes, environmental compliance management, regulatory interpretation, environmental documentation control, and sustainability initiatives. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
Communication: Effective written and verbal communication skills with working proficiency in English for international collaboration and documentation.
  
Teamwork: Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams, external stakeholders, regulatory authorities, and service providers.
  
  
**Complementary skills**  
  

* Postgraduate qualification in Occupational Health and Safety.
* Experience supporting environmental audits, corrective action programs, and compliance

improvement initiatives.  

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and regulatory deadlines.
* Demonstrated commitment to sustainability, environmental stewardship, and continuous

improvement programs.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. **Job Description:**

**About our cybersecurity team**

Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading tech companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that! We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced GRC specialist to join our Cybersecurity team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

**About the role**

As GRC Certification Specialist at HPE, you will be responsible for monitoring and reporting on security programs related to customer facing applications and services. Your role will focus on maintaining the security and compliance of HPE products and cloud services and HPE certification and compliance efforts. You will leverage GRC expertise and audit experience to protect HPE applications and HPE customer data.

**About You**

You will have expertise in GRC tools and platforms to monitor and report on application security programs and their compliance. Your knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform will enhance your ability to asses and advise on security issues within applications on these platforms. You will work independently and on high-impact projects in fast-paced environments, with advanced expertise across cyber and IT security.

Your experience with IT service accreditation, attestation, and certification frameworks such as CSA CCM, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, SOC2, and ISO 27001, including how to obtain these accreditations and how to maintain them, will be critical. Strong communication skills are essential, enabling you to explain complex technical issues to non-technical audiences.

description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**Position Summary**

**Build Distributed Systems at Global Scale — Join Harness Feature Management & Experimentation (FME)**

Last year, the Harness FME platform evaluated **4 trillion feature flags**. For most people, that’s just an impressive number. For a scale-minded builder and engineering leader, it represents one of the most demanding challenges in distributed systems.

To power this scale, we’ve built:

* **Massive global concurrency** supporting millions of real-time decisions.
* **Millisecond-level latency** through a globally distributed feature flag delivery network.
* **Tier-one enterprise reliability** trusted by the world’s most sophisticated companies.

**About the Role:**

* Design and develop scalable backend services using Java/Golang
* Architect and maintain distributed microservices-based systems.
* Build reliable APIs and internal platform services using REST(gorilla.mux, alice.chains) and gRPC.
* Optimize system performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking layers.
* Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, S3, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Deploy and manage cloud-native applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Troubleshoot complex production and infrastructure-level issues.
* Drive engineering best practices, code quality, and system reliability.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership across teams.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.

**About you**

* 8-11 years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Go, C++ and Java.
* Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management, CPU/process architecture, containers, cgroups, and filesystems.
* Strong experience designing and building scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL (including pgx driver), Redis, and object storage systems such as S3.
* Solid experience working within AWS environments and familiarity with core cloud infrastructure concepts including VPCs, load balancers, auto scaling, and compute instances. Exposure to Azure or GCP is a plus.
* Experience building and operating cloud-native applications using Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and related orchestration tooling.
* Strong understanding of API design and backend communication patterns, including
* REST APIs, gRPC, and middleware frameworks such as gorilla/mux and alice.
* Proficient with Git-based development workflows and modern software delivery practices.
* Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues beyond application code.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to operate independently in fast-paced engineering environments.
* Proven experience mentoring engineers, driving technical discussions, and leading initiatives across teams

**Nice-to-have :**

* Prior experience writing security policies for API gateways or load balancers.
* Contributions to open-source projects.

**What you will have at Harness**

* Experience building a transformative product
* End-to-end ownership of your projects
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefit
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement
